fees.label: Tier 2 (complex needs), child aged 5 and over

feesNote: Newcastle adds a weekly fee for each child on top of the allowance; the fee depends on the tier of care (Tier 3 is for children with disabilities or severe emotional and behavioural needs) and the child's age.
extras: Tier 4 (Build a Future, and parent and child placements) pays a combined allowance and fee of £760 a week per child
Tier 5 (Change a Future) pays a combined allowance and fee of £1,015 a week per child, and emergency foster carers can receive a £350 retainer
Daily and half-day rates are published for respite care at each tier
summary: Newcastle pays the same weekly allowance by the child's age at every tier, plus a weekly fee per child that rises with the complexity of the child's needs, so a Tier 1 carer receives £288.65 to £426.98 a week for one child. The council's page does not state which year the rates apply to, so we have listed them under the current financial year; check the latest figures with the fostering team.
